title: Rigidity and Gap Phenomena in the Sphere--Ball Correspondence
summary: This survey reviews a collection of parallel phenomena between free boundary submanifolds in the Euclidean unit ball and closed submanifolds in the sphere, with particular emphasis on rigidity mechanisms, pinching thresholds, and canonical models. We do not regard the two theories as a unified system in one-to-one correspondence. Rather, we emphasize that in several typical settings -- including low topology, strong pinching, spectral extremality, and symmetry reduction -- the free boundary condition often forces stronger rigidity in the unit ball than in the closed setting.
